issues.description: Step label mismatch: Header shows 'STEP 4 OF 4' but the URL is /design/step-6, indicating this is step 6 of the flow. The step counter is wrong.
issues.root_cause: In the step-6 page component (likely pages/design/step-6.tsx or similar), the step indicator is hardcoded or incorrectly set to '4 OF 4' instead of the correct step number for this page. The totalSteps or currentStep prop/constant is misconfigured.

issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors (7+ instances of 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML') causing the entire root to switch to client rendering. This indicates server-side rendered text differs from client-side rendered text.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic content (likely timestamps, random values, or browser-only APIs like window/navigator) is being rendered during SSR and producing different output on the client. Could be in QR code generation, date/time display, or random key generation within step-6 or its child components.

issues.description: The page is mounted as 'step-6' per console logs but the URL routing appears correct (/design/step-6). However, the UI displays 'STEP 4 OF 4' suggesting the step progress component is not reading the correct step number for step-6.
issues.root_cause: The StepHeader or ProgressBar component likely has TOTAL_STEPS=4 and currentStep is derived from the route but step-6 maps to step 4 (perhaps only 4 visible steps). If the design flow has 4 user-facing steps but step-6 is the 4th, the label may be intentional but conflicts with the URL naming convention, causing confusion. Alternatively the mapping object is off by one.

issues.description: Upload zone appears incomplete - bottom text is cut off and not fully visible. The drag-and-drop instruction text is truncated.
issues.root_cause: The upload zone container has insufficient height or overflow:hidden set, clipping the instructional text below the camera icon. CSS height constraint on the dashed border container.

issues.description: The 'Scan QR Code' tab option text shows 'Scan QR' on top line and 'Code' on second line, suggesting awkward text wrapping in the tab button.
issues.root_cause: The tab button for QR code lacks sufficient width or has word-break/white-space styling causing the label to wrap mid-phrase. The button or its text container needs white-space: nowrap or more width.

fixes.reason: If the flow actually has 6 steps (step-1 through step-6), total steps should be 6. Adjust based on actual flow length.
The step indicator shows STEP 4 OF 4 but this is step-6, so currentStep and totalSteps need to reflect the correct values.
Dynamic values like Date.now() and Math.random() used during SSR cause hydration mismatches. Moving them into useEffect ensures they only run client-side.

fixes.old_str: className="border-2 border-dashed border-gold/40 rounded-lg h-64 flex flex-col items-center justify-center"
fixes.new_str: className="border-2 border-dashed border-gold/40 rounded-lg min-h-64 h-auto py-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center"
fixes.reason: Fixed height h-64 clips the instructional text below the camera icon. Using min-h-64 with auto height and padding allows content to show fully.
Prevents the 'Scan QR Code' label from wrapping mid-phrase onto two lines.
